summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of pickling a figure with aligned labels by removing weak references from the state dictionary. The change appears to be minimal and directly related to the problem.

issues.description: Removing all weak references from the state might inadvertently remove other necessary weak references that are not causing the pickling issue. This could lead to unexpected behavior or memory management issues.
The added comment could be more descriptive about why weak references are being removed. It might be helpful to mention the specific issue they cause with pickling.
